lines.en: I am so sorry I am late; the traffic was much worse than usual.
Please forgive me for forgetting your birthday; it will not happen again.
I would have called you, but my phone had died on the way home.
Sorry to bother you, but could you help me carry this box?
I apologize for the mistake in the report; I have already corrected it.
He did not come to the meeting because he had to take his mother to the doctor.
It was my fault, and I take full responsibility for what happened.
She apologized for not answering earlier, saying she had been in meetings all day.
I hope you can accept my apology; I never meant to upset you.
Next time I will leave home earlier so that this does not happen again.
